about: Trading hours and holidays for the market clocks in the page header. Times are local exchange time; the page converts them to IST. Holidays are weekdays only (weekends are always closed). Add the next year's holidays when the exchanges publish them (China usually in December, see UPDATING.md).

markets.name: Lithium carbonate futures, Guangzhou Futures Exchange
markets.hours_note: Day session only; lithium carbonate has no night session.
markets.source: Nanhua Futures, China futures trading hours (Nov 2024)
markets.holiday_source: Shanghai Futures Exchange 2026 holiday schedule (China's futures exchanges close on the same national holidays), via Mondo Visione

markets.name: London Metal Exchange, LMEselect electronic market
markets.hours_note: Ring (open outcry) trading runs 11:40 to 17:00 London time; the inter-office telephone market is open 24 hours.
markets.holiday_source: England and Wales bank holidays (GOV.UK dates), via Hoseasons

update.note: The site's data is refreshed every morning at about 4:00 am IST; the morning email follows at 5:15 am.
